title: fix(slack): log skipped mentions when channel lookup fails
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Related to #128301. When a cold-cache Slack `app_mention` cannot resolve its channel type because `conversations.info` fails, the monitor skips the event without an INFO diagnostic. This change makes that intentional skip visible; it does not claim to fix the separately reported paired-message delivery loss.

## User Impact

The existing unresolved-type skip logs a validated channel ID and a closed failure category, without message text or raw provider errors. Routing, deduplication, channel-type ownership, and outbound calls are unchanged. Original implementation and credit: @Olli0103.

## Evidence

Verified head `e53b267a74a0718e0e14e188577b8f794b62fe67` after merging current main because the touched Slack owners changed upstream.

- Built isolated Gateway with the real Slack plugin against Crabline 0.1.28, HTTP ingress, and mention-required channels. A provider proxy returned `missing_scope` for `conversations.info` in the failing channel. Baseline owner files emitted no skip diagnostic; the candidate emitted `app_mention skipped: conversation type unresolved; channelId=<fixture> lookupFailureCategory=permission; waiting for message event`. Neither private-text nor raw-error sentinel appeared in the candidate log.
- Controls: successful lookup delivered `OPENCLAW_E2E_OK` through Slack on both versions; an unmentioned message in the failing channel produced no reply on either. Both versions made exactly the same outbound API method counts: auth.test 4, conversations.info 3, users.info 6, reactions.add 6, conversations.history 1, chat.postMessage 1, reactions.remove 3. The sole message write targeted the successful channel.
- Candidate focused suites: 2 files / 90 tests passed, 25.56 s wrapper wall. The retained listener regression failed against baseline production files because the INFO logger received zero calls (9.01 s wrapper wall). These are local Docker measurements; new-head hosted CI timing is separate.
- Candidate build passed. Initial setup attempts were corrected before proof: concurrent build/test input changes and missing postbuild metadata were harness failures, not product results.
- One real `gpt-5-mini` call through the candidate Gateway returned `P157953_LIVE_OK` with HTTP 200, reasoning low and a 4096-token output budget (140 completion tokens, including 128 reasoning tokens). The task credential was deleted afterward. Slack itself was mocked; no live Slack workspace was touched.

Maintainer intent: Sarah's Enterprise Grid policy/routing changes (#125009, #122346, #121373, #121014, #120944, #120087) and Pash's reply-ordering change (#119832) remain unchanged: this diff only carries a sanitized lookup failure to the existing unresolved-type return and logs it. No compact progress or delivery behavior changes.
